findings.title: Spec class_path points at a re-export
findings.detail: deeptutor.capabilities.reading.tools:ViewFigureTool is imported into deeptutor/capabilities/reading/tools.py but defined in deeptutor/capabilities/reading/figure_view.py; import resolution works, but the catalog indirection is one hop deeper than it looks
findings.suggestion: consider pointing the spec at the defining module

findings.title: Orphan BaseTool subclass not declared in the catalog
findings.detail: class EditFileTool (name='edit_file') inherits BaseTool but has no BUILTIN_TOOL_SPECS entry; its module is imported nowhere in deeptutor/ runtime code (tests only), so the registry can never serve it
findings.suggestion: declare it in builtin_specs.py or remove the dead implementation (+ its test)

findings.title: PARTNER_BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES duplicated but currently in sync
findings.detail: two hand-maintained copies match today; a future edit on one side would silently diverge
findings.suggestion: single-source the tuple (one module defines it, the other imports)

findings.title: AGENTS.md toggle table missing a user-toggleable tool
